motions.topic: TEST ELECTROSTATIC COMPLEMENTARITY: assign residue-level partial charges (K/R +1, D/E -1, H +0.5), compute the charge-complementarity of the cognate interface (opposite charges on contact pairs = attractive = specific) vs a centroid-aligned random antigen, and run the same specificity test. PREDICTION: cognate electrostatically more complementary (attractive) than random by >2sigma, IF the specificity signal is in the charge. MEASURED: six negatives. (1) fp16 only, (2) parts not interface, (3) scorer not search, (4) sequence no signal, (5) contact count sticky, (6) contact distance sticky (closeness proxy confounded by clashes). The paratope is sticky at every geometric level. REFRAME: specificity may not be geometric at all — it may be in the CHARGE (electrostatic complementarity) or the BONDS (H-bond directionality). Two probes: EL1 electrostatic complementarity (the reframe test), SC2 true surface-normal Sc (geometric completion).
